verdict.rationale: DBOS lets code start workflows in the background (DBOS.start_workflow) and enqueue many workflows on queues with managed concurrency, which supports imperative fan-out. External code can interact with a DBOS app through DBOSClient, and a community user built an exactly-once Kafka event pipeline. However, nothing shows declarative event or webhook trigger bindings or a built-in one-event-to-many-functions subscription model. Messages go to one specific workflow, not broadcast. Missing for 10: declarative event/webhook trigger annotations, documented pub/sub fan-out of one event to multiple handlers, first-party docs on queue- or event-source-triggered workflows (Kafka evidence is community-only).
